description: This Java interface defines a contract for pipeline functions within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders package. It includes methods for obtaining function names, signatures, applying functions, and nested interfaces for signature details and parameter definitions.

classes.name: PipelineFunction
classes.description: Interface representing a pipeline function with methods for retrieving its name, signature, and applying the function with given parameters, including nested interfaces for signature and parameter definitions.

classes.name: PipelineFunction.Signature
classes.description: Nested interface defining the signature of a pipeline function, including methods to retrieve parameter definitions and render the signature as a string.

classes.name: PipelineFunction.ParameterDefinition
classes.description: Nested interface representing a parameter in a function's signature, with methods to get the parameter's name, type, and description.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the pipeline function.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature details of the pipeline function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the pipeline function with a given input value, parameter string including parentheses, and an expression resolver, returning the processed result.
